QUIC varint and packet header encode/decode helpers.

# Purpose
This header file defines helper functions and macros for QUIC packet parsing and encoding. It includes routines to build and read QUIC variable-length integers, to set and extract packet header fields, and to form packet type and packet number length values from header bytes. It also provides a macro, `FD_QUIC_ENCODE_VARINT`, that writes a QUIC varint into a buffer after checking that enough space is available. The file is a small utility header used by other QUIC code to handle packet format details without repeating bit and byte operations.
